body.statement: For every admissible compact family \(\mathcal K\), \(\sup_{Q\in\mathcal K}P_{N,Q}\{\mathbb P_{N,Q}\notin\mathcal U_{\mathrm{rr}}\}\to0\). Consequently, uniformly over \(Q\in\mathcal K\), the empirical moment vector is computed by the same all-active full-rank recursion with probability tending to one; every \(K_{D_t^{\star}D_t^{\star}}^{N}\) has smallest eigenvalue exceeding \(\underline\kappa\), and every \(\rho_t^{N}\) exceeds \(\underline\rho\).
body.justification: This interior-stability result makes the observable empirical statistic use the same full-rank recursion as its population limit.
body.gap: Standard laws of large numbers do not by themselves record stability of every recursively generated Gram inverse and Schur residual in this adaptive reused-matrix system.
body.consumer: The covariance implementation may run the ordinary full-rank derivative recursion without data-dependent deletion on events whose probability tends to one.
